Horny goat weed contains icariin, a compound that may increase blood flow and mimic some effects of testosterone. People primarily use it to treat erectile dysfunction, low libido, and fatigue, though human clinical evidence remains limited.

Potential Benefits

  • Improves Circulation: It acts as a mild PDE5 inhibitor, similar to how some prescription ED medications function.
  • Hormonal Support: Some studies suggest it might help balance estrogen or testosterone levels.
  • Bone Health: Research indicates it may help prevent bone loss in postmenopausal women.

Risks and Side Effects

  • High Doses: Can cause dizziness, vomiting, dry mouth, or nosebleeds.
  • Interactions: It may interact poorly with blood thinners or blood pressure medications.

turns.prompt_text: What does to tonkat ali root
turns.response_html:
Tongkat ali (also known as "Longjack") is an herbal supplement derived from the roots of the Eurycoma longifolia tree native to Southeast Asia. It is primarily used to support hormonal health and energy.

Primary Effects

  • Hormonal Support: It is widely used to naturally boost testosterone levels, particularly in men with low baseline levels. It works by encouraging the body to release "free" testosterone from binding proteins.
  • Libido and Fertility: Studies suggest it may improve sexual desire, erectile function, and sperm quality (motility and concentration).
  • Stress Reduction (Adaptogen): It may help lower cortisol (the stress hormone), which can lead to improvements in mood, reduction in tension, and better sleep.
  • Athletic Performance: Some athletes use it to improve body composition and muscle strength, though evidence for endurance performance is less consistent.

Considerations and Safety

  • Effectiveness: While promising, many studies are small or based on animal models. It typically takes 2–8 weeks of consistent use to notice significant hormonal or sexual benefits.
  • Side Effects: At typical doses, side effects are rare but can include insomnia, irritability, or restlessness (likely due to the increase in energy).
  • Interactions: It may interfere with blood pressure medications (specifically propranolol) or blood sugar medications (by increasing the risk of hypoglycemia).
  • Precautions: Because it can increase testosterone, it is generally advised that individuals with hormone-sensitive conditions (like prostate or breast cancer) or liver disease avoid it.
